name: dsh-codebase-memory
description: DSH bundle that bridges the Codebase Memory MCP code knowledge graph into DSH via the official @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client. Pins the Windows AMD64 release of codebase-memory-mcp@0.10.8 by SHA-256 and exposes all mcp__codebase_memory__* tools natively. Includes a Graph UI on http://127.0.0.1:9749. Standalone Cordis bundle patch — no dsh source changes.
